description.narrative: Pakistan, HIV, Ministry of National Health Services, Regulations and Coordination of Pakistan (NACP)This program has the following goals: Halt New Infections and Improve the Quality of Life for People Living with HIV and AIDS. To reduce morbidity and mortality due to HIV and AIDS and scaling up of comprehensive services to PWIDUs, PLHIV and their families. The objectives of this program are: Environment for effective AIDS Response is Enabled. HIV Prevention is increased and sustained among key populations (PWID, MSM, transgender persons) and their sexual partners and children. HIV related mortality and morbidity is reduced through available and equitable access to quality continuum of care services
